name: @forest/index
description: The Forest index: reads signed records from the hosts it lists, the registry's rows of the issuers it trusts, and the escrow's own events, scores every profile (uniqueness, standing and rating, never blended, each signed twice), publishes its ratings as a signed reputation tree and shows the reputation proofs profiles carry, and serves the same data as pages for people and for machines: HTML, JSON-LD, a JSON twin of every page, a sitemap, llms.txt and the read skill.

scripts.test: node --test --test-force-exit test/markets.test.ts test/scoring.test.ts test/sign.test.ts test/server.test.ts test/pages.test.ts test/reputation.test.ts test/e2e.test.ts
